description: Bhuvan Indian Geoportal (ISRO / NRSC) is a data portal run by National Remote Sensing Centre, Indian Space Research Organisation. Bhuvan is the national geoportal with satellite imagery, thematic land-use and land-cover, urban, road and water layers, and disaster services for flood, landslide, cyclone, drought and fire, with data download and web services. Coverage: India. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, wms, shp; access is free of charge; downloads need a free registration. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Bhuvan-Indian Geoportal of ISRO") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard mapping and infrastructure exposure studies of India. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
